correctness.rationale: The 15-vertex dual has exactly (15,105,195,90) nonempty faces and no five-faces; its 90 tetrahedra form ten disjoint-support triangulated three-sphere blocks. Their primitive images give free H3 rank 10 and no H2 torsion, while missing-triangle cones show pi1=0 and Euler characteristic gives H2 rank 24. Integral Alexander duality and the full nine-skeleton give 8-connectivity; Hurewicz and Whitehead establish X ~= 10 S9 wedge 24 S10. The embedded standard-library code exhaustively verifies all faces and 260 cones and independently checks boundary ranks over 2,3,5,7. Modular ranks are not used as an integral torsion proof.
